description: reload_bench, 5.2k-line module, 20 fresh processes per variant, mirrored order gcbase,gcnc,gcnc,gcbase x10, 45 edits per process. 'gcbase' = main 904c9cbea (concurrent GC), 'gcnc' = System.GC.Concurrent=false. Per edit: index, kind (1=L1,2=L2,3=L3), save->visible ms, server emit ms, analyzer ms. Peak compile-server RSS (ps, 4 runs per arm): gcbase 238-253 MB, gcnc 310-318 MB.
